title: JIOS Aerogel Corporation
content: JIOS Aerogel Corporation is a Singapore-based company that specializes in the development and production of aerogel materials and products. The company has developed a proprietary aerogel production technology that significantly reduces manufacturing costs while maintaining high quality standards. JIOS Aerogel produces aerogel powder, aerogel blankets, and aerogel panels for applications in oil and gas, construction, industrial insulation, and lithium-ion battery safety. The company has strategic partnerships with major energy companies and has expanded its operations to serve the Asia-Pacific market.
